Implemented cmd/replay to re-ingest 18.4M lost events from the 12/11 raw archive into events.replay.v3, including per-partition ordering and a rejects file for malformed lines. A dry run completed successfully with a 5k batch size, and PR #233 is open waiting for Daniel's review.

- [en-cours] Real replay into events.replay.v3 and aggregator backfill.

- [décision] Replay all events into events.replay.v3 without age cutoff (source: t05).
- [décision] Do not draft the ETA reply for Rachel (source: t19).
